svg.title: Research paper: PredictLab
svg.desc: Research paper: PredictLab, an AI-powered multi-disease clinical risk prediction platform using machine learning and large language model explanations. By Vinayak K V, published 17 May 2026 on Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20253956, CC BY 4.0. Animated figures: a linear SVM boundary for diabetes, a random forest for stroke and a logistic curve for heart disease. Figures are schematic. Llama 3.1 8B explains each result in plain language, as a risk indicator rather than a diagnosis.
svg.text: plain language, as a risk indicator
